There is now a native macOS version as well (first version): on an Apple silicon Mac it starts on double click and works with keyboard, mouse and gamepad. Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15) has a community port (developer preview) that has reached the character selection screen only on its author's device; see the device table below. new.name: ahwootech/BRUTAL
new.desc: A free, open source C# framework for making games, or your own game engine. Direct access to native APIs and Vulkan, with the low-level libraries around them. The foundation under Kitten Space Agency and RimWorld's Waylith engine.
new.readme: BRUTAL Framework A free, open source C framework for making games, or your own game engine. BRUTAL is a framework. You can make a game directly with it, or use it as the foundation for a separate engine. We made Kitten Space Agency directly on BRUTAL. Ludeon built their Waylith engine on it to move RimWorld off Unity. At its core is a custom interop layer giving C direct access to native APIs and libraries. Around that we've built mathematics, memory management, strings, collections, job scheduling, logging, localization, and bindings for Vulkan, GLFW, Dear ImGui, FMOD, RakNet, Jolt and Box2D. BRUTAL doesn't make the architectural decisions for you. You write your own stack. You can use whatever NuGet packages you want, including third party ones. It's called BRUTAL for a reason. new.readme: Solid Glass The style · Install · What is here · Contributing A refined glass inspired aesthetic that feels solid from afar and reveals its subtle materiality up close. Delicate highlights, fine borders, and soft shadows create depth, while a restrained finish emphasizes clarity, stability, and a sense of solidity over transparency, refraction, and fluidity. That is one of the blocks: whole screens made of the components, to look at, read and copy in. Below, the components themselves. It stands between flat design and liquid glass. new.name: opengeos/RustGIS
new.desc: A fast, free and open-source GIS in pure Rust.
new.readme: RustGIS A fast, free and open source GIS in pure Rust for mapping, analyzing and sharing geospatial data. Native on Windows, macOS and Linux, and in your web browser. Your data stays on your machine unless you send it to an AI model you choose, and every action is a command you can script. Why RustGIS Fast and small. One native program, drawn on the GPU, with no runtime to install and no server to run. Runs everywhere. The same app on Windows, macOS and Linux, and compiled to WebAssembly at web.rustgis.app with nothing to install. Local and private. Your files are read and written on your machine, and nothing is uploaded on its own. The network is used only when you ask for it: web basemaps, plugins, the GeoLibre tools and the AI model you pick, which receives your questions and the data it reads to answer them. Everything is a command. Every button in the ribbon is a command with an id.

new.readme: CodeAgent 自学习 AI Agent 命令行工具——交互体验对标 claude code，Windows 优先，开箱即用。 English 简体中文 CodeAgent 是一个跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手：你用自然语言下指令，它读代码、改文件、跑命令、查资料，把活干完。它有自己的一套「长本事」机制——从对话轨迹里沉淀可复用的技能，越用越顺手。 🧭 这是一份手写的「中文版 claude code」 不是套壳，也不是翻译——是从交互界面到 Agent 主循环一行行手写出来的完整实现， 注释全是中文 ： 📚 想学 Agent 开发？这就是活教材。 工具自注册、上下文分级压缩、权限审批、子代理团队、工作流引擎、记忆系统——一个真实可跑的 Agent 全链路都在这儿，每个模块都是「大白话流程 → 参数 → 返回」的保姆级中文注释，读代码像读教程。 🛠 欢迎上手改。 觉得哪里不顺手？fork 了直接改——代码结构清晰、注释到位，改起来不费劲。欢迎 PR：修 bug、加功能、优化界面都行。 💬 有问题社区问。 卡住了、看不懂了、想讨论设计，直接去 Issues 或 Discussions 发帖，有问必答。 ✨ 特性 终端体验（对标 claude code） 流式回答圆角框、思考流暗色框、工具事件行（ ● Bash(...) + ⎿ 结果 ） 危险命令 / 白名单外写文件的 审批面板 ：允许一次 / 总是允许 / 拒绝三选，面板答完自擦不污染上下文 Ctrl+C 语义分明：回合中一键中断、双击强退；审批面板上 Ctrl+C 一击取消并中断整轮 皮肤系统、页脚状态栏、命令补全、输入历史、粘贴大段文本自动落盘引用 模型与工具 多模型接入：OpenAI 兼容协议（默认 DeepSeek）与 Anthropic 协议均可配；主模型 + 辅助小模型（压缩/检索/记忆提取等杂活走便宜模型） 工具自注册体系： tools/ 下模块 import 即登记，按「套餐」（toolset）控制发给模型的工具集 MCP 外部工具：项目级 .mcp.json 声明即接入，首次连接需审批 内置工具覆盖文件

new.name: AgriciDaniel/compass
new.desc: Compass: run your whole life out of Obsidian. Daily questions, quarterly retreats, planning, habits, tasks, writing, and an AI assistant in the vault.
new.readme: Life OS Run your whole life out of Obsidian: one honest question set a night, everything else follows. Compass is a complete Obsidian vault template of the system Mike Schmitz describes in "How I Run My Whole Life Out of Obsidian": journaling with daily questions, quarterly personal retreats, multi scale planning, habit tracking, daily reading, task management, writing boards, and a DataviewJS dashboard that ties it together. The first party Life OS application now sits above those workflows, with an AI assistant that reads AGENTS.md and runs a library of approval aware prompts. Everything remains plain Markdown and properties. Ten community plugins and the first party Life OS plugin ship inside the folder with their licenses. Status: development candidate, not a newly accepted public release. The existing 1.0.2 archives predate the Life OS application. The next template candidate is 1.1

new.name: obsidianmd/knap
new.desc: A simple template language that turns data into Markdown.
new.readme: Knap Knap is a simple template language that turns data into Markdown using variables, filters, and logic. It powers templating in Obsidian Web Clipper and Obsidian Importer. Documentation · Playground Knap parses templates into an AST and interprets them without eval or arbitrary JavaScript execution. Applications control the data and integrations available to templates. Install Node.js 20 or later is required for the CLI. CLI Render a template with JSON data: Knap also supports inline templates, validation, batch rendering, CSV input, and offline language help. See the CLI guide. Library See the API guide for rendering, validation, custom filters, asynchronous variables, HTML filters, and execution limits. Syntax highlighting Knap syntax highlighting is available for .knap and .knap.md templates: VS Code and Cursor: Download knap.vsix from the latest release, then choose Extensions: In

new.name: atlas-vtt/atlas-vtt
new.desc: Open Source virtual tabletop for Obsidian: battle maps, tokens, fog of war, dice, initiative and a separate player view.
new.readme: AtlasVTT A game system agnostic virtual tabletop for tabletop RPGs that runs inside Obsidian. The guides, with screenshots and clips of every feature, are on atlas vtt.dev . I built Atlas as part of my bachelor's thesis to give the TTRPG community a virtual tabletop that's open source, hackable, and free to use. Every file Atlas creates, every token, every map, every world you build, stays yours and stays local. It follows the same philosophy as Obsidian: your work lives on your machine, in formats you control, with no account and no server in between. Atlas VTT also has an online play service, Atlas Online, to share your maps with players over the internet. Atlas Online requires an account and an internet connection. TTRPG worlds in my opinion are something very personal and players and DMs get attached to them. That attachment deserves better than a subscription and someone else's data

new.name: joeseesun/qiaomu-cover-fonts
new.desc: 乔木封面设计的默认开源字库：中文与英文 OFL 字体，子集化并附授权 · Default open-licence font library for Qiaomu Cover Design
new.readme: 乔木封面字库 · Qiaomu Cover Fonts 乔木封面设计（Qiaomu Cover Design） 的默认字库：一套随插件交付、装好就能用的封面字体。不追求数量， 中文 19 款、英文 15 款 ，每一款都在封面上有明确的位置；全部 SIL Open Font License 1.1，中文覆盖《通用规范汉字表》8105 字，共 30.7 MB。 The default font library of Qiaomu Cover Design: 34 curated open licence fonts (19 Chinese, 15 Latin, 30.7 MB) that every cover can use out of the box, all under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. 先说结论 1. 不需要装进电脑系统。 插件自己把字体载入画布，导出的图片里字已经是像素，换台电脑看也一样。 2. 门槛是“打包权”。 只有 SIL OFL 开源字体允许随产品分发、并为了体积做子集化；大厂“免费商用”字体多数禁止修改或单独再分发，不能放进默认包。每一款都读过字体文件里的授权声明，并核对了保留字体名。 3. 第一次打开静默下载。 Obsidian 插件商店只安装 3 个文件，所以字库从这里分发：插件首次打开时在后台下载，默认模板要用的字优先，用到哪款就立刻下哪款，逐个校验 SHA 256，之后离线可用。 4. 模板只用字库里的字 ，新用户第一次看到的就是设计稿原样。 5. 以“字体搭配”为单位排版。 标题、正文、英文数字三个角色一次定好，AI 也按搭配来设计。好的排版靠层级和搭配，不靠字体多。 12 套字体搭配 每张都是在乔木封面设计里用同一个版式、换不同搭配实际渲染的。标题用中文展示字体，副标题用安静的正文字体，期号和英文角标自动换成搭配里的英文字体。 编辑杂志 editorial 思源宋体 Heavy · 思源黑体 · Instrument Serif 深度长文、观点、访谈 文化书卷 literary 朱雀仿宋 · 霞鹜

new.readme: Fluvy A premium theme and card library for Home Assistant. Try it: acosta290.github.io/fluvy — the real cards, pages and settings panel on a simulated home, in your browser. Fluvy brings one design to the whole of Home Assistant: a theme, fifty two cards, five automatic dashboards, a settings panel, the Activity and History pages, and Home Assistant's own pages restyled to match — all from one set of design tokens, installed as one integration through HACS. Every card is drawn on a 4 px grid, checked by an alignment measurer, and holds from a phone to a wall tablet, in light and dark, in eight languages. The whole app, one design The sidebar, the header, the tabs, the dialogs, the settings pages: with the Fluvy theme on, Home Assistant looks like it was designed with the cards, because it was — the same tokens, the same type (Inter), the same radii and hairlines. Three kinds of sensor What you get How 🚪 States Garage door open, closed or halfway , gate shut, lights on in the shed Click a few examples of each state; it learns in about a second 🧍 Objects & people Emma is home , our car is in the driveway , a cat on the lawn, an unknown person at the door Pick from 80 objects — no training. Name people by their face once; every camera knows them 🔢 Readings The water, gas or power meter, the minutes left on the washer Draw a box around the number. Counters only go up and land in the Energy dashboard Real meters — the rolling wheels of a water meter, read right even while a wheel is half way between two digits. new.name: Gamer92000/echo-dot-assist
new.desc: Turn Amazon Echos (Echo Dot 3, Echo Dot 2, Echo 2) into local Home Assistant voice satellites. Keeps Amazon's mic processing and wake word engine, replaces Alexa with a small C daemon speaking ESPHome or Wyoming. Multiroom music via Music Assistant, Bluetooth speaker and proxy, no cloud.
new.readme: echo dot assist Turn an old Amazon Echo into a Home Assistant voice satellite that never talks to Amazon. The Echo keeps what it is good at: Amazon's microphone processing and wake word engine, so it still hears you across the room and over its own music. Only Alexa goes. In its place runs hassmic , a small daemon that Home Assistant finds as an ESPHome device, with no YAML and no add on. [!CAUTION] Vibecoded, unaudited, your risk. Code, notes and docs were written by an AI (Claude) in conversation with the author, and tried on one Echo of each model. The install unlocks the bootloader and writes the system partition: it can brick the Echo. A mistake in the firewall or the updates could leave it online or open on your network. Read what you run. new.name: bertel2020/HA-Housekeeper
new.desc: Maintenance explorer for Home Assistant: inventory, diagnosis, impact analysis and confirmed, reversible cleanup
new.readme: HA Housekeeper Maintenance and analysis for Home Assistant: inventory, diagnostics, and dependencies at a glance. Deutsche Version HA Housekeeper is a maintenance and analysis integration for Home Assistant. It creates a clear inventory of your installation, explains suspicious or orphaned objects, and shows how entities, devices, integrations, areas, and automations depend on each other. The goal is not aggressive automatic cleanup. Housekeeper helps you understand what exists, why something is considered problematic, and what a cleanup or repair would affect before you confirm it. Housekeeper reads and analyzes first. It changes something only after you explicitly confirm a plan. Plans cover quarantine and removal, repairs, replacing references, renaming entities, assigning areas, deleting unused automations, trimming recorder history and other maintenance tasks. new.name: AboveColin/HA-Jev
new.desc: Ask your house a question, get a number back. Home Assistant integration for TypeSafe Jev: typed answers as sensors, four actions for automations, and a conversation agent for Assist.
new.readme: Jev for Home Assistant Ask TypeSafe Jev questions about your house and get numbers back. Jev is a decision model, not a chat model. It answers a typed question with a probability, a choice or a score, and this integration turns each answer into an entity you can automate on. Full documentation Not affiliated with TypeSafe. The API client is jevclient. What it does Questions become sensors: a probability, one of your options with its distribution, or a number on a scale. Add them in the UI, in YAML, or both. Five actions, jev.noul , jev.choice , jev.score , jev.ask and jev.box , answer inside an automation and return a response variable. An AI Task entity answers ai task.generate data when it is called. new.name: kedube/ha-iss-tracker
new.desc: ISS Tracker for Home Assistant: predicts when the International Space Station passes overhead and follows it on a 3D globe.
new.readme: ISS Tracker for Home Assistant Know when to step outside and look up. This custom integration predicts when the International Space Station will be visible from your home: above your horizon, lit by the Sun, while your sky is dark. It gives you advance notice, the direction to look, how high it will climb, and how bright it will be, a calendar of the visible passes, and an ISS Tracker page with a 3D Earth that shows the station flying round it at its true altitude. All prediction runs locally inside Home Assistant using SGP4, the standard model for published satellite orbital elements and the one that pass prediction sites such as Heavens Above and N2YO also rely on. Predictions need only the station's published orbit, downloaded a few times a day and cached so they keep working through internet outages. new.name: aronreid/ups-to-esp32
new.desc: Put a USB-only UPS on the network: an ESP32-S3 board and firmware that serves NUT on TCP 3493, with a web UI. No host computer, no Raspberry Pi.
new.readme: My UPS Pal Put a USB only UPS on your network for the cost of a $6 board: no Pi, no SD card to corrupt, no vendor network card that costs more than the UPS. My UPS Pal was called the UPS to ESP32 Module until October 2026. Boards on the old name keep updating as before. Plug it into your UPS's USB port and it speaks the real Network UPS Tools protocol on TCP 3493, so Home Assistant, Synology, TrueNAS, unraid and upsmon see a normal upsd and connect exactly like they would to one, because it is one, not an approximation.    The problem A UPS in a rack, a basement or a cupboard has exactly one monitoring interface: a USB type B socket. The usual fix is a Raspberry Pi parked beside it running NUT: an entire Linux computer, its own power draw, its own SD card to corrupt, to do nothing but translate one protocol.
